name: Site Studio Configuration Management
description: Provides Site Studio recommended configuration management using config filter, config ignore & config split module.
project_description:
The Site Studio provides a recommendation that the best practice for managing Site Studio configuration is to use the Config Ignore and Config Split module. Configuring this module, removes the Site Studio configuration from Drupal Core configuration export and import process and the recommendation can be seen here .

 The Site Studio Configuration Management module offers a comprehensive out-of-the-box configuration, eliminating the need for manual setup. Additionally, it automates the export and import of Site Studio configuration with every configuration export/import command (i.e drush cex or drush cim ) This eliminates the requirement to manually run the Site Studio package export/import command, making the process seamless and hassle-free.
